question_en: In 3Ø loco, to isolate panto No. 2 keep panto selector switch in......... position and close......... coc.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, पेंटो नंबर 2 को अलग-थलग रखने के लिए पेंटो सिलेक्टर स्विच ... पोजीशन और क्लोज ... कोक में रखें।
explanation: Placing panto selector switch 85/ZPT on position I raises only Pantograph-1, and isolating pneumatic cock PAN-2 prevents air from entering Pantograph-2 cylinder.

question_en: In 3Ø dead loco, ...... coc should be open for charging BP pressure into auxiliary reservoir.
question_hi: 3Ø मृत लोको में, ......। बीपी दबाव को सहायक जलाशय में चार्ज करने के लिए कोक खुला होना चाहिए।
explanation: In 3-phase locos fitted with CCB/E-70 brake systems, cock 47 (Dead Engine Cock) is opened to allow train BP pressure to charge the locomotive auxiliary reservoir for proportional braking.

question_en: While 3Ø loco working as banker, put on ......... switch and close 70 cut out cock.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको बैंकर के रूप में काम करते हुए, ......... स्विच ऑन करें और 70 कट आउट कॉक बंद करें।
explanation: ZBAN is the Banking Operation Switch. Closing cock 70 isolates BP charging, and switching ON ZBAN prevents automatic penalty brake interventions during banking.

question_en: For resetting VCD in WAG 9 or WAP 7 loco, wait for ...........seconds.
question_hi: WAG 9 या WAP 7 लोको में VCD को रीसेट करने के लिए, ......... Seconds का इंतजार करें।
explanation: The enforced penalty recovery time delay for the computerized Vigilance Control Device (VCD) in WAG-9 / WAP-7 is 160 seconds before the penalty brake can be reset.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-17 belongs to ................... sub system.
explanation: In diagnostic software, Sub-system SS-17 corresponds to Processor FLG-1 (Vehicle Control Logic Unit 1).

question_en: To perform shunting with 3Ø loco, keep ............ switch in ......... position.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको के साथ शंटिंग करने के लिए, स्विच रखें .........।
explanation: Configuration switch 160 placed in position 0 engages Shunting Mode, which automatically limits the maximum locomotive speed to 15 km/h.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-01 belongs to ................... sub system.
explanation: SS-01 designates the Main Power circuit (catenary supply, VCB, primary transformer, and catenary sensors).

question_en: While working with WAP-7 or WAG-9 with light load, if Harmonic filter is isolated, work with normal speed after isolating .................
question_hi: लाइट लोड के साथ यदि हार्मोनिक फ़िल्टर को अलग किया जाता है, तो किसके अलगाव के बाद सामान्य गति से काम करें
explanation: Harmonic filter resistance is linked with Bogie-1; isolating Traction Converter-1 eliminates the filter requirement and allows normal speed on Bogie-2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to isolate VCD, keep ...................switch in ............ position.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, VCD को अलग करने के लिए, स्विच को किस स्थिति में रखें:
explanation: Rotary switch 237.1 in SB-2 placed in position 0 electrically isolates the VCD system.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Battery charger is getting supply from ...............
explanation: Auxiliary Converter No. 3 (BUR-3) provides constant 415V AC 3-phase supply to feed the on-board battery charger (CHBA).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, if battery voltage drops below .................. volts, loco will shut down.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, यदि बैटरी वोल्टेज नीचे गिरती है तो लोको बंद हो जाएगा:
explanation: Priority-2 alert triggers at <92V; if the control voltage drops below 82V continuously, Central Electronics executes an emergency shutdown.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Battery charger output MCB No. is .......... and its location is at...............
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, बैटरी चार्जर आउटपुट MCB No. है और इसका स्थान है:
explanation: MCB 110 (110V DC battery charger output) is located in control cubicle SB-2.

question_en: In 3 phase locos, normal position of direct brake handle (SA9) in rear cab is............
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, रियर कैब में प्रत्यक्ष ब्रेक हैंडल (SA9) की सामान्य स्थिति है:
explanation: Direct brake controller SA-9 in the trailing/rear non-working cab must always remain pinned in Release position.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, VCD is required to be acknowledged from ............. kmph of speed.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, वीसीडी को किस गति से स्वीकार करने की आवश्यकता होती है:
explanation: VCD monitoring stays in sleep mode at standstill and starts its 60-second vigilance cycle once loco speed exceeds 1.5 km/h.

question_en: In 3 phase locos, when parking brakes are released, PB gauge shows .......... Kg/cm².
question_hi: जब पार्किंग ब्रेक जारी किए जाते हैं, तो पीबी गेज दिखाता है:
explanation: Compressed air at 5.0 kg/cm² enters PB cylinders to compress the internal mechanical spring, releasing the brake shoes.

question_en: During loco brake testing of WAG-9 or WAP-7, loco should not move up to ......... kN.
question_hi: लोको ब्रेक परीक्षण के दौरान, लोको को कितने kN तक नहीं चलना चाहिए:
explanation: With full direct brake application (SA-9 at 3.5 kg/cm²), the locomotive must hold standstill against tractive effort up to 150 kN.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, HOM is operated with .............. key.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में, HOM को किसके साथ संचालित किया जाता है:
explanation: High-voltage grounding switch HOM is unlocked and interlocked using key IG-38 (Blue key).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, continuous pressing of PSA for more than 60 seconds is called as ............... mode.
question_hi: 60 सेकंड से अधिक समय तक लगातार PSA दबाने को क्या कहा जाता है:
explanation: Holding an acknowledgment switch (foot pedal PSA / BPVG) depressed continuously beyond 60 seconds is treated as Dead man mode, triggering an emergency penalty brake.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Constant speed control (CSC) can be activated above ......... kmph of speed.
question_hi: CSC को किस गति से ऊपर सक्रिय किया जा सकता है:
explanation: CSC automatically disables below 5 km/h and cannot be engaged until train speed crosses 5 km/h.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, for 'Driving' mode, move BL key from ......... position to ......... position.
question_hi: ड्राइविंग मोड के लिए, BL कुंजी को किस स्थिति से किस स्थिति पर ले जाएं:
explanation: Turning the master key from 'OFF' to 'D' powers driving circuits, awakens both cabs, and charges the parking brake cylinders.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Auxiliary converter No 2 feeds ................ motors.
question_hi: सहायक कनवर्टर नंबर 2 किन मोटरों को फीड करता है:
explanation: In standard 3-phase converter arrangements, BUR-2 feeds TMB-1 & 2 and OCB-1 & 2 (Oil Cooler Blowers).

question_en: While energizing 3Ø loco, if UBA meter is showing '0' and corridor lights also not glowing check, MCB No. .......... is tripped.
question_hi: यदि UBA मीटर '0' दिखाए और गलियारे की रोशनी भी बंद हो, तो कौन सा MCB ट्रिप है:
explanation: MCB 112.1 controls battery power supply to Central Electronics (CEL) and general cab control distribution buses.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, for charging of BP pressure, .............. coc to be kept open.
question_hi: बीपी प्रेशर चार्ज करने के लिए कौन सा कॉक खुला रखा जाना चाहिए:
explanation: Cut-out cock 70 on the pneumatic brake panel directly controls Brake Pipe (BP) charging.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, if vigilance penalty brakes are applied BP pressure drops to ......... kg/cm².
question_hi: सतर्कता पेनल्टी ब्रेक लगने पर बीपी प्रेशर कितने तक गिरता है:
explanation: A VCD penalty initiates full service braking, venting BP down to 2.5 to 3.0 kg/cm².

question_en: Maximum permissible speed of WAG-9 loco is ............ Kmph.
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको की अधिकतम अनुमेय गति (MPS) कितनी है:
explanation: Standard freight workhorse WAG-9 is geared for a maximum operational speed of 100 km/h.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, on moving BL key from 'D' to 'OFF' position, ............. Brakes will apply automatically.
question_hi: BL कुंजी को 'D' से 'OFF' पर ले जाने पर कौन से ब्रेक स्वतः लागू होंगे:
explanation: Moving the key to 'OFF' exhausts the solenoid magnet valve line, setting the spring-loaded Parking brakes.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, parking brakes are applied and released through ............ switch in Panel 'A'.
question_hi: पार्किंग ब्रेक किसके माध्यम से पैनल 'A' से लगाए और जारी किए जाते हैं:
explanation: Illuminated spring push-button BPPB (Push Button Parking Brake) applies and releases parking brakes from the cab desk.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-14 belongs to ............... sub system.
question_hi: SS-14 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: In locomotive diagnostics, SS-13 designates Cab-1 and SS-14 designates Cab-2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, if ZBAN is switched ON in working cab, ................... happens.
question_hi: यदि कार्यरत कैब में ZBAN चालू किया जाए, तो क्या होगा:
explanation: Turning ON ZBAN vents BP to 0 kg/cm² from the banker cab, leaving train brake control exclusively to the leading train engine.

question_en: Hotel load facility is available in ............... loco(s).
question_hi: होटल लोड की सुविधा किन लोकोमोटिव्स में उपलब्ध है:
explanation: Hotel load converters (supplying 750V 3-phase for coach AC/pantry) are standard on WAP-5 and designated modified HOG WAP-7 locomotives.

question_en: In 3Ø MU locos, .................... panto of leading loco and ................... panto of trailing loco will raise.
question_hi: 3Ø MU में, लीडिंग लोको का कौन सा और ट्रेलिंग लोको का कौन सा पैंटो उठेगा:
explanation: Raising the Trailing panto of leading loco and Leading panto of trailing loco maximizes mechanical distance between pans to prevent OHE wave resonance oscillations.

question_en: While clearing 3Ø loco (provided with Knorr brake) as dead, mode switch position in both cabs is ...........
question_hi: डेड लोको को ले जाते समय दोनों कैब में मोड स्विच की स्थिति क्या होगी:
explanation: The CCB mode rotary switch must be turned to Trail in both cabs to make brake valves passive and responsive to incoming train BP signals.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, pressing of BPVG continuously for more than 60 seconds is called as .............. mode.
question_hi: BPVG को 60 सेकंड से अधिक दबाने को क्या कहा जाता है:
explanation: Holding vigilance push button BPVG continuously jammed for >60 s triggers the Dead man mode safety penalty.

question_en: Total oil points in WAG 9 or WAP 7 locos are ...........
question_hi: WAG 9 या WAP 7 लोको में कुल तेल जांच बिंदु कितने हैं:
explanation: Includes 13 oil sight glasses: Main Transformer (1), Traction Converters (2), Main Compressors (2), Axle Gear Cases (6), and Center Pivot Gear points (2).

question_en: To apply parking brakes in 3Ø dead loco, press ............. side plunger of solenoid valve.
question_hi: 3Ø मृत लोको में पार्किंग ब्रेक लगाने के लिए सोलेनॉइड वाल्व का कौन सा प्लंजर दबाएं:
explanation: On solenoid valve 30, depressing the Left side plunger manual pin releases air pressure, applying parking brakes.

question_en: Three phase loco is having ............... no. of three phase auxiliary motors.
question_hi: 3-चरण लोको में 3-फेज ऑक्जीलरी मोटरों की कुल संख्या है:
explanation: Standard configuration has 12 three-phase AC induction motors (2 TMB, 2 OCB, 2 CP, 2 TFP oil pumps, 2 SR oil pumps, and 2 scavenge blowers).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, UBA meter needle deviates when BL key is in ............. mode(s) of BL key.
question_hi: UBA मीटर की सुई कब विचलित होती है:
explanation: Battery circuit contactor closes and provides 110V DC bus potential to voltmeter UBA in either Driving (D) or Cooling (C) mode.

question_en: If speed of the train is increased more than ........... than loco MPS, emergency brake will apply in 3Ø loco.
question_hi: यदि ट्रेन की गति लोको MPS से कितने से अधिक बढ़ जाए तो आपातकालीन ब्रेक लगेगा:
explanation: Overspeed protection generates an audio-visual beep at +0.5%; if speed reaches 5% above MPS, VCB opens and automatic emergency braking applies.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Constant speed control (CSC) will be de-activated automatically if BP pressure drops more than ......... Kg/cm².
question_hi: बीपी दबाव में कितने से अधिक गिरावट पर CSC स्वतः डी-एक्टिवेट हो जाएगा:
explanation: A pressure reduction greater than 0.25 kg/cm² indicates a service application and drops CSC immediately.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to isolate truck No.2 (traction converter-2), keep .......... switch in ............ position.
question_hi: ट्रक नंबर 2 (ट्रैक्शन कनवर्टर-2) को अलग करने के लिए स्विच को किस स्थिति में रखें:
explanation: Switch 154 placed in position II isolates Bogie-2 traction power.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-10 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-10 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: Sub-system SS-10 designates the computerized Brake System.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, location of TM Blower-1 is ....................
question_hi: टीएम ब्लोअर -1 का स्थान कहाँ है:
explanation: TM Blower-1 is installed in Machine Room No. 2 near Cab-1.

question_en: In ................ gradient area and terminal goods yards Constant speed control (CSC) of 3 phase loco should not be used.
question_hi: किस ढाल क्षेत्र में CSC का उपयोग नहीं किया जाना चाहिए:
explanation: In Steep down gradients, regenerative brake cycling can cause runaways; manual graduated control is mandatory.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, acknowledge the fault message by pressing ................. button.
question_hi: फॉल्ट संदेश को स्वीकार करने के लिए कौन सा बटन दबाएं:
explanation: Illuminated push button BPFA on Panel-A acknowledges screen faults and stops fault alarms.

question_en: While working 3Ø loco as banker, close ............ coc in pneumatic panel.
question_hi: बैंकर के रूप में काम करते समय कौन सा कॉक बंद करें:
explanation: Cock 70 isolates BP charging from the banking engine.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to reset the Fire detection unit (FDU) press the ................. button.
question_hi: फायर डिटेक्शन यूनिट (FDU) को रीसेट करने के लिए कौन सा बटन दबाएं:
explanation: After confirming no fire in the machine room, press the dedicated manual Reset button directly on the FDU unit in SB-2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, ............... auxiliary motors works only in cooling mode.
question_hi: कौन सी सहायक मोटरें केवल कूलिंग मोड में काम करती हैं:

options.A: All three Ø and single Ø motors
options.B: All single Ø motors and MCP 1&2

explanation: In cooling mode, single-phase machine room blowers and Main Compressors (MCP 1&2) operate to ventilate and charge reservoirs while traction systems sleep.

question_en: In three Ø loco, if 'Catenary voltage out of limit' appears on screen, change ............... fuse after lowering panto.
question_hi: कैटेनरी वोल्टेज आउट ऑफ लिमिट दिखने पर कौन सा फ्यूज बदलें:
explanation: Replace the primary roof/panel Potential Transformer (PT) fuse.

question_en: In three Ø loco, SS-09 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-09 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: SS-09 designates the on-board Battery and low voltage DC auxiliary network.

question_en: In 3 phase knorr brake loco, rear cab mode switch position is ..................
question_hi: नॉर ब्रेक लोको में रियर कैब मोड स्विच की स्थिति क्या होगी:
explanation: Rear/non-driving cab mode switch must always be in Trail.

question_en: To reset VCD in WAP-5 loco, wait for ............. seconds.
question_hi: WAP-5 लोको में VCD को रीसेट करने के लिए कितने सेकंड का इंतजार करें:
explanation: Conventional E-70 fitted WAP-5 software maintains a 120-second penalty reset interlock.

question_en: In 3 phase loco cab changing is to be done with in ............. minutes otherwise CE will switch OFF.
question_hi: कैब बदलने का कार्य कितने मिनट में पूरा किया जाना चाहिए:
explanation: In self-hold mode, Central Electronics remains awake for 10 minutes before powering down.

question_en: In 3 phase locos, Harmonic filter resistances are cooled by .................
question_hi: हार्मोनिक फिल्टर प्रतिरोधों को किसके द्वारा ठंडा किया जाता है:
explanation: Located on the locomotive roof, they are naturally cooled by ambient Atmospheric air.

question_en: In 3 phase locos, in cooling mode, for panto and DJ ................. motor creates pressure.
question_hi: कूलिंग मोड में पेंटो और डीजे के लिए कौन सी मोटर दबाव बनाती है:
explanation: The baby auxiliary compressor (MCPA) runs on battery DC to build pneumatic control pressure.

question_en: In three Ø loco potential transformer is connected to ................. roof bar.
question_hi: पोटेंशियल ट्रांसफार्मर किस रूफ बार से जुड़ा होता है:
explanation: The high voltage primary PT is tapped off the Middle central high-voltage roof busbar.

question_en: The position of mode switch in leading cab of 3Ø loco provided with Knorr brake is ..................
question_hi: अग्रणी कैब में मोड स्विच की स्थिति क्या होगी:
explanation: Active driving cab must be set to Lead.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, normal position of 152 switch is ..................
question_hi: स्विच 152 की सामान्य स्थिति क्या होती है:
explanation: Position '1' is the standard normal running position.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, positions of 154 Switch are ..................
question_hi: स्विच 154 की स्थितियां क्या हैं:

options.B: NORM, I, II and I & II

explanation: Has four operational selections: NORM (both active), I (Bogie-1 isolated), II (Bogie-2 isolated), and I & II (both isolated).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-04 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-04 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: SS-04 corresponds to the Harmonic Filter circuit.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-08 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-08 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: SS-08 designates Auxiliary Converter No. 3 (BUR-3).

question_en: In 3Ø loco provided with Knorr brake, Auto brake valve (A9) handle can be locked or unlocked in ..... position.
question_hi: A9 हैंडल को किस स्थिति में लॉक या अनलॉक किया जा सकता है:
explanation: The locking pin on the A-9 handle engages only when placed in Neutral position.

question_en: Three phase loco is having ................ number of roof bars.
question_hi: 3-चरण लोको में कुल कितनी रूफ बार होती हैं:
explanation: Standard high-voltage roof busbar has 3 interconnected rigid segments.

question_en: Three phase loco having .............. number of additional cocks (total coc on both sides).
question_hi: दोनों ओर कुल अतिरिक्त कॉकों की संख्या कितनी होती है:
explanation: 4+4 (4 on Cab-1 end buffer beam and 4 on Cab-2 end: BP, FP, BC equalizing, and MR equalizing cocks).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-05 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-05 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: Sub-system SS-05 designates the Hotel Load Converter.

question_en: WAG-9 loco is provided with ......... No. of direct brake cylinders and ......... No. of parking brake cylinders.
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में प्रत्यक्ष ब्रेक और पार्किंग ब्रेक सिलेंडरों की संख्या है:
explanation: 12 direct brake cylinders (one per wheel) and 4 spring parking brake cylinders (on wheels 2, 6, 7, and 11).

question_en: 3 phase loco is fitted with ....................... type of traction motors.
question_hi: 3-चरण लोको में किस प्रकार के ट्रैक्शन मोटर लगाए जाते हैं:

options.A: 3Ø AC Asynchronous squirrel cage induction motor

explanation: Powered by robust 3-phase asynchronous squirrel-cage induction motors (type 6FRA 6068 / 6FXA 7059).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, position of control electronics (CE) during cab changing is ..................
question_hi: कैब बदलने के दौरान कंट्रोल इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स की स्थिति क्या होती है:
explanation: Moving BL key to OFF engages Self hold mode, maintaining processor memory while the crew shifts cabs.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, location of BPFL switch is ....................
question_hi: BPFL स्विच का स्थान कहाँ है:
explanation: Emergency flasher light toggle push button BPFL is located on Panel-C.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, during self hold mode, CE will remain in ON for ............ minutes.
question_hi: सेल्फ होल्ड मोड में CE कितने मिनट तक ऑन रहेगा:
explanation: CE holds power internally for 10 minutes before executing automatic battery cutoff.

question_en: To move 3Ø loco as live or dead ensure ................... brakes are released.
question_hi: लोको को ले जाने के लिए किन ब्रेकों का रिलीज होना सुनिश्चित करें:
explanation: Both Parking brakes and Proportional / direct brakes must be fully released (gauges at 0 kg/cm² for BC and 5 kg/cm² for PB).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, if throttle (ATDC) is failed, keep ................ switch in ............ position.
question_hi: यदि थ्रॉटल (ATDC) विफल हो जाए तो स्विच को किस स्थिति में रखें:
explanation: Switch 152 placed in position 1 / Failure Mode permits clearing section using alternative step controls.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, when parking brakes are applied, parking brake gauge shows .................
question_hi: पार्किंग ब्रेक लगाने पर पार्किंग ब्रेक गेज क्या दिखाता है:
explanation: Venting air pressure to 0 kg/cm² allows springs to exert mechanical braking force on wheels.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-15 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-15 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: SS-15 designates the digital Memotel / Speedometer recording sub-system.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to isolate panto No.1 keep panto selector switch in ............... position.
question_hi: पेंटो नंबर 1 को अलग करने के लिए पेंटो सिलेक्टर स्विच को किसमें रखें:
explanation: Setting selector switch to II raises Pantograph-2 exclusively, isolating Pantograph-1.

question_en: Location of Emergency stop push button switch in 3Ø loco is ..................
question_hi: इमरजेंसी स्टॉप पुश बटन स्विच का स्थान कहाँ है:
explanation: Prominently provided on Panel-A of both cabs.

question_en: WAG-9 or WAP-7 locos are having ............ number of dampers.
question_hi: WAG-9 या WAP-7 लोको में कुल डैम्पर्स की संख्या कितनी है:
explanation: Total 20 hydraulic dampers: 8 primary vertical, 4 secondary vertical, 4 secondary lateral, and 4 yaw dampers.

question_en: Location of MCP-2 in three Ø loco is ...................
question_hi: MCP-2 का स्थान कहाँ है:

options.A: Loco left side below Machine room No.1
options.B: Loco right side below Machine room No.2

explanation: Suspended in the underframe on the Loco right side below Machine Room No. 2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, glowing of BPFA and flickering of LSFI indicates ................. fault.
question_hi: BPFA जलने और LSFI के झिलमिलाने से किस फॉल्ट का संकेत मिलता है:

options.D: Both Priority-1 & 2 faults at a time

explanation: Indicates a Priority-2 fault requiring acknowledgment.

question_hi: 3Ø लोको में 'F0201P1' का विस्तार करें:
explanation: Decodes as Fault (F), Subsystem 02 (Traction Bogie-1), Fault code 01, and Priority-1 (P1).

question_en: In 3Ø locos, VCD is required to acknowledge once in every ............ seconds.
question_hi: VCD को कितने सेकंड में एक बार स्वीकार करना आवश्यक है:

options.D: 160 in WAG-9 or WAP-7 & 120 in WAP-5

explanation: The vigilance monitoring cycle requires driver acknowledgment at least once every 60 seconds.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, on run glowing of BPFA alone indicates ................. fault.
question_hi: चलते समय केवल BPFA के जलने से किस फॉल्ट का संकेत मिलता है:

options.B: One of the sub system is isolated

explanation: A steady illuminated BPFA without flickering indicates an acknowledged Priority-2 alert.

question_en: Location of Harmonic filter resistances in 3Ø loco is ..................
question_hi: हार्मोनिक फ़िल्टर प्रतिरोधों का स्थान कहाँ है:

options.D: By the side of pneumatic panel

explanation: Mounted externally on the Loco roof.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to bring isolated sub system into service, procedure is ...............
question_hi: आइसोलेटेड सब-सिस्टम को पुनः सेवा में लाने की क्या प्रक्रिया है:

options.C: Switch OFF and switch ON CEL

explanation: Must Switch OFF and switch ON Central Electronics (recycle CEL) so software scans and reconfigures hardware.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Status code '00' means ...................
question_hi: स्थिति कोड '00' का क्या अर्थ है:

options.D: No fault and No sub system isolated

explanation: Status '00' confirms a completely healthy vehicle: No fault and No subsystem isolated.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Auxiliary converter No 3 feeds ................. motors.
question_hi: सहायक कनवर्टर नंबर 3 किन मोटरों को फीड करता है:
explanation: In standard running scheme, BUR-3 feeds all these units.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, in case of emergency, ALP can stop the train by operating ...................
question_hi: आपातकाल के मामले में एएलपी ट्रेन को किसके द्वारा रोक सकता है:

options.D: Emergency stop switch or Emergency brake valve

explanation: Can activate either the electrical Emergency stop switch (BPEMS) or the manual pneumatic Emergency brake flap valve.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Constant speed control (CSC) will be de-activated automatically if throttle is disturbed above .............% in TE or BE side.
question_hi: थ्रॉटल को कितने % से अधिक हिलाने पर CSC स्वतः रद्द हो जाता है:

options.D: No such limit, on moving throttle

explanation: There is no percentage deadband; any positive physical movement of the master throttle automatically cancels CSC.

question_en: WAG-9 loco is having ........................ type of bogie.
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में किस प्रकार की बोगी होती है:
explanation: High tractive effort Co-Co tetra mount high adhesion fabricated bogie.

question_en: Procedure for quick charging of BP pressure in 3Ø loco is ..................
question_hi: BP प्रेशर की त्वरित चार्जिंग की प्रक्रिया है:
explanation: Holding A-9 briefly in Release position delivers high pneumatic volume and overcharges BP to 5.4 kg/cm².

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Machine room blowers & their scavenging blowers work in ................. Mode(s).
question_hi: मशीन रूम ब्लोअर और स्केवेंजिंग ब्लोअर किस मोड में काम करते हैं:
explanation: Operates across both Driving mode and Cooling mode to purge contaminants and cool machinery.

question_en: In WAG-9 or WAP-7, location of air dryer is ....................
question_hi: WAG-9 या WAP-7 में एयर ड्रायर का स्थान कहाँ है:

options.A: Behind cattle guard-1 in left side
options.C: Behind cattle guard-1 loco pilot side
options.D: Behind cattle guard-1 in ALP side

explanation: Installed under the chassis behind cattle guard-1 on the Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) side.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-06 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-06 किस सब सिस्टम के अंतर्गत आता है:
explanation: Sub-system SS-06 corresponds to Auxiliary Converter No. 1 (BUR-1).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Continuous glowing of LSFI indicates ...................
question_hi: LSFI की निरंतर चमक क्या इंगित करती है:

options.B: At least one sub system is isolated

explanation: A steady non-flashing yellow pilot lamp LSFI signals that at least one sub-system has been isolated.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, location of MCP-1 is ....................
question_hi: MCP-1 का स्थान कहाँ है:
explanation: Main Compressor 1 is mounted on the underframe below Machine Room No. 1.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, 3Ø scavenging blower collects dust from air filters of ................... & ...................
question_hi: स्केवेंजिंग ब्लोअर किनके एयर फिल्टर से धूल एकत्र करता है:
explanation: Draws particulate buildup out of the inertial cyclonic filters of both the Oil Cooling Blower and Bogie Traction Motor Blower.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to switch OFF control electronics procedure of operating BL key
question_hi: CE बंद करने के लिए BL कुंजी के संचालन की प्रक्रिया क्या है:
explanation: Rotate from 'D' to 'OFF' and wait 2 to 4 seconds for the internal processors to cleanly save diagnostic logs.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, for cooling mode procedure of operating BL key is ...................................
question_hi: कूलिंग मोड के लिए BL कुंजी संचालन की प्रक्रिया क्या है:
explanation: Turn from 'OFF' to 'C' and hold 2 to 4 seconds.

question_en: Three phase loco is having ............... number of auxiliary converter(s).
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में ऑक्जीलरी कनवर्टर की संख्या कितनी है:
explanation: Standard 3-phase locos have 3 auxiliary converters (BUR-1, BUR-2, and BUR-3).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, when harmonic filter is isolated, speed of the train is restricted to .................
question_hi: हार्मोनिक फ़िल्टर अलग होने पर ट्रेन की गति कितने तक सीमित होती है:
explanation: Speed is restricted to 40 km/h to prevent primary voltage resonance on the overhead contact line.

question_en: To raise the pantograph in 3Ø loco, ensure ................. node information (in driving mode) on screen.
question_hi: पैंटोग्राफ उठाने के लिए स्क्रीन पर कौन सी नोड जानकारी सुनिश्चित करें:
explanation: Diagnostic screen must show status node FLG-504 (Control electronics ready for VCB closing and panto raise).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to switch on flasher light ............... switch to be operated.
question_hi: फ्लैशर लाइट चालू करने के लिए कौन सा स्विच ऑपरेट करें:
explanation: Toggle switch BPFL manually turns on the twin amber flasher light units.

question_en: In modified WAP-7 loco, ............. wheels are having parking brakes facility.
question_hi: संशोधित WAP-7 लोको में किन पहियों में पार्किंग ब्रेक की सुविधा है:
explanation: In the modified lightened WAP-7 variant, parking brake units are reduced to Wheels 2 and 11.

question_en: 3Ø loco is having .................... No. of 3 phase auxiliary motors in loco under frame.
question_hi: अंडरफ्रेम में 3-फेज सहायक मोटरों की संख्या कितनी है:
explanation: 2 motors (Main Compressor 1 and Main Compressor 2).

question_en: If RS pressure is below 5.2 Kg/cm² and MCPs are not working, MCPA starts automatically provided BL key is in ............... position.
question_hi: RS दबाव 5.2 से कम होने पर MCPA कब स्वतः शुरू होता है:
explanation: MCPA automatic start logic engages whenever the key is active in either 'C' or 'D'.

question_en: In 3Ø loco before operating throttle, ensure ............... node information on screen.
question_hi: थ्रॉटल चलाने से पहले स्क्रीन पर कौन सी नोड जानकारी सुनिश्चित करें:
explanation: Node FLG-590 confirms that traction converters are ready and tractive effort interlocks are satisfied.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-03 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-03 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: SS-03 designates Traction Bogie-2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, Oil cooling blower cools ................. & ................. oils.
question_hi: ऑयल कूलिंग ब्लोअर किन तेलों को ठंडा करता है:
explanation: Radiator elements cool both the Main Transformer (TFP) oil and Traction Converter (SR) coolant oil.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to isolate truck No.1 (traction converter-1), keep ............ switch in ......... position.
question_hi: ट्रक नंबर 1 को अलग करने के लिए स्विच को किस स्थिति में रखें:
explanation: Switch 154 placed on I position isolates Bogie-1.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, if battery voltage drops to ......... volts for 30 seconds, P-2 message appears.
question_hi: बैटरी वोल्टेज 30 सेकंड के लिए कितने वोल्ट तक गिरने पर P-2 संदेश आता है:
explanation: An alert triggers at 92 Volts.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, for application of parking brakes speed should be below ...................
question_hi: पार्किंग ब्रेक लगाने के लिए गति कितने से नीचे होनी चाहिए:
explanation: Parking brakes must only be applied when locomotive speed is at Zero km/h (dead stop).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-16 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-16 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: Designated in early vehicle software for Vehicle Processor FLG-1 communication bus.

question_en: In proportional working, maximum brake cylinder pressure in WAG-9 loco is ............... kg/cm².
question_hi: WAG-9 में अधिकतम आनुपातिक ब्रेक सिलेंडर दबाव कितना होता है:
explanation: Distributor valve proportional limiting valve caps BC pressure at 2.5 kg/cm².

question_en: In 3Ø loco, normal position of panto selector switch is ..................
question_hi: पेंटो सेलेक्टर स्विच की सामान्य स्थिति क्या होती है:
explanation: Switch 85 is kept on Auto so the rear pantograph raises automatically relative to directional travel.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, location of Fire detection unit (FDU) is ...................
question_hi: फायर डिटेक्शन यूनिट (FDU) कहाँ स्थित होती है:
explanation: Mounted inside auxiliary control cubicle SB-2.

question_en: 3Ø loco is having ................. number of battery boxes.
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में बैटरी बॉक्स की संख्या कितनी होती है:
explanation: Has 2 battery boxes (one on left underframe side, one on right underframe side).

question_en: 3Ø loco having ......... number of single phase 415V auxiliary motors.
question_hi: एकल चरण 415V सहायक मोटरों की संख्या कितनी है:
explanation: 4 motors (2 Machine Room Blowers MRB-1 & MRB-2, and 2 Scavenge Blowers for MRB).

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to operate reverser ensure ......... node information on screen and MR pressure should be more than 6.4 kg/cm².
question_hi: रिवर्सर को संचालित करने के लिए स्क्रीन पर कौन सी नोड जानकारी सुनिश्चित करें:
explanation: Node FLG-550 confirms pneumatic and electrical conditions are met for throwing reversers.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, battery charger input MCB No. is .......... and located in ...................
question_hi: बैटरी चार्जर इनपुट MCB No. है और कहाँ स्थित है:
explanation: Three-phase AC input breaker MCB 100 is located inside cubicle HB-2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, if speed is more than ......... % than loco MPS, only audio visual indications will appear.
question_hi: गति लोको MPS से कितने % अधिक होने पर केवल दृश्य-श्रव्य संकेत दिखाई देंगे:
explanation: At 0.5% overspeed, the driver receives warning chimes without penalty brake intervention.

question_en: Parking brake is provided to .................. wheels in WAG-9 loco.
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में किन पहियों में पार्किंग ब्रेक प्रदान किया जाता है:
explanation: Fitted on outer wheels of both bogies: 2, 6, 7 & 11.

question_en: Over current relay in 3Ø loco is ..................
question_hi: 3Ø लोको में ओवरकरेंट रिले कौन सा है:
explanation: Primary catenary overcurrent protection relay is OCR-78.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, SS-18 belongs to ................. sub system.
question_hi: SS-18 का संबंध किस सब सिस्टम से है:
explanation: SS-18 designates vehicle logic Processor FLG-2.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, normal position of ZTEL switch is ..................
question_hi: ZTEL स्विच की सामान्य स्थिति क्या होती है:
explanation: Kept normally in OFF position.

question_en: In 3Ø loco, to close the DJ, ensure ......... node information on screen.
question_hi: डीजे बंद करने के लिए स्क्रीन पर कौन सी नोड जानकारी सुनिश्चित करें:
explanation: FLG-504 confirms vehicle ready to close main circuit breaker (VCB/DJ).

question_en: When ZTEL is switched ON Tractive Effort (TE) is limited to ...... KN in WAG-9.
question_hi: ZTEL ऑन होने पर ट्रैक्टिव एफर्ट कितने kN तक सीमित हो जाता है:
explanation: ZTEL limits tractive effort to 300 kN to protect wagon couplers from snatching.

question_en: GR stuck up in between notches, DJ will trip through .................
question_hi: जीआर नॉचों के बीच अटकने पर डीजे किसके माध्यम से ट्रिप होगा:
explanation: In between notches, tap-changer interlock drops Q-44, tripping DJ after 0.6 seconds.

question_en: In WAG-9 loco Panto selector switch is provided on .................
question_hi: पेंटोग्राफ सिलेक्टर स्विच कहाँ दिया गया है:
explanation: Switch 85 (ZPT) is mounted directly on driver Panel 'A'.

question_en: In WAG-9 loco No. of positions of panto selector switch are .................
question_hi: पेंटोग्राफ सिलेक्टर स्विच के कुल कितने स्थान होते हैं:
explanation: Has 4 positions: Auto, I, II, and 0 (isolated).

question_en: ZBAN switch is provided on .................
question_hi: ZBAN स्विच कहाँ दिया गया है:
explanation: Located on driver Panel 'A'.

question_en: In WAG9 loco No. of positions of BLCP are .................
question_hi: BLCP स्विच के कितने पोजीशन होते हैं:
explanation: Has 3 positions: OFF, AUTO, and MANUAL (DIRECT).

question_en: To release the parking brake, Loco Pilot has to press .................
question_hi: पार्किंग ब्रेक रिलीज करने के लिए क्या दबाना होगा:
explanation: Push button BPPB.

question_en: Gear ratio of WAG-9 Loco is ..................
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको का गियर अनुपात क्या है:
explanation: Standard bull gear to pinion ratio is 77:15 = 1:5.133.

question_en: Secondary suspension vertical damper is provided .................
question_hi: सेकेंडरी सस्पेंशन वर्टिकल डैम्पर कहाँ लगा होता है:

options.B: Bogie frame and Loco body under frame

explanation: Installed between the Bogie frame and locomotive body underframe.

question_en: New wheel diameter of WAG9 Loco is ..................
question_hi: WAG9 लोको का नया पहिया व्यास कितना होता है:
explanation: New wheel diameter is 1092 mm (condemning limit is 1016 mm).

question_en: Parking Brake cannot be activated if the speed of the Locomotive exceeds .................
question_hi: किस गति से अधिक होने पर पार्किंग ब्रेक सक्रिय नहीं हो सकता:
explanation: Speed interlock prevents PB application above 5 km/h to avoid severe wheel flat spots.

question_en: In ABB loco fault message can be acknowledged by pressing .................
question_hi: ABB लोको में फॉल्ट संदेश को स्वीकार करने के लिए क्या दबाएं:
explanation: Yellow push button BPFA.

question_en: BPPB is the switch for .................
question_hi: BPPB किसके लिए स्विच है:

options.B: Push button switch for Parking brake

explanation: Push button switch for Parking brake.

question_en: Is the BPFA switch for .................
question_hi: BPFA स्विच किसके लिए है:

options.B: Push button switch for Parking brake
options.C: Push button switch for fault acknowledgement

explanation: Push button switch for fault acknowledgement.

question_en: Failure mode operation switch in WAG-9 loco is ..................
question_hi: WAG-9 लोको में विफलता मोड ऑपरेशन स्विच कौन सा है:
explanation: Rotary switch 152 is the Failure Mode Operation switch.

question_en: Parking brake applied automatically by putting ..................
question_hi: पार्किंग ब्रेक स्वचालित रूप से कब लागू होते हैं:
explanation: Moving master BL key from 'D' to 'OFF'.

question_en: Pneumatic control key is provided on .................
question_hi: वायवीय नियंत्रण कुंजी कहाँ प्रदान की जाती है:
explanation: Key 16-38 is mounted on the Pneumatic Panel.

question_en: Oil pump for converter-1 is provided near .................
question_hi: कन्वर्टर 1 के लिए तेल पंप किसके पास दिया गया है:
explanation: Located adjacent to Oil Cooling Unit-1 / Traction Converter-1.

question_en: The colour of BPPB is ..................
question_hi: BPPB का रंग क्या है:
explanation: Standard push button lamp housing color is Red.

question_en: In WAG-9 loco during priority 1 fault ..................
question_hi: WAG-9 में प्रायोरिटी 1 फॉल्ट के दौरान क्या संकेत मिलता है:

options.C: BPFA will glow and LSFI also flickers

explanation: BPFA glows continuously and pilot lamp LSFI flickers rapidly.

question_en: If the Catenary voltage is out of limits, what indication will you get in WAG-9 Loco?
question_hi: यदि कैटेनरी वोल्टेज सीमा से बाहर हो तो क्या संकेत मिलेगा:

options.A: U meter needle will deviate and LSDJ remain extinguish
options.B: U meter needle will deviate and fault message will display on screen

explanation: Voltmeter U-meter drops/spikes and diagnostic screen generates F0101P1 / Catenary Voltage Out of Limits.

question_en: What will happen when Transformer oil temperature increases in WAG-9 Loco?
question_hi: ट्रांसफार्मर तेल का तापमान अत्यधिक बढ़ने पर क्या होगा:

options.A: VCB will open and F0105P1 fault message will display on screen
options.B: VCB will not open and F0106 P2 fault message will display on screen

explanation: Protective thermostat drops VCB and generates F0105P1 (Transformer Oil Overtemperature).

question_en: MCB no 47.1/1 is provided in ..................
question_hi: MCB नंबर 47.1/1 किस पैनल में दिया गया है:
explanation: Main Compressor-1 protection breaker 47.1/1 is located inside HB-1 panel.

question_hi: BZ-V-O-F का अर्थ क्या है:
